# Marshall Elliott

## Overview

- **Age:** About fifty years old  <sub>[v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c9 P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)</sub>

## Appearance

For fifteen years, Marshall Elliott allowed his hair and beard to grow long and unshaven in fulfillment of a political vow, giving him a peculiar Viking-like appearance. After his political party won the election, he had his beard shaved off and his hair trimmed by a barber.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c16 P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c35 P28](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0028)_

## Personality

Marshall Elliott is a witty, intelligent, and well-read man who possesses a knack for telling stories. He is extremely determined, stubborn, and known to have a bit of a temper, while also sharing in good humor and jokes.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c16 P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 c35 P28](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0028), [v4 c37 P15](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0015), [v4 c37 P17](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0017)_

## Goals

- To keep his vow until the Liberal party won power  <sub>[v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034)</sub>

## History

Born a Grit, Marshall Elliott campaigned intensely for his political party during a particularly bitter general election fifteen years earlier. Confident in a Liberal victory, he made a public vow not to shave his face or cut his hair until the Grits achieved power. Following their defeat, he steadfastly kept his word for fifteen years despite his eccentric appearance. Over the years, he maintained a friendship with Captain Jim, occasionally joining him for cod-fishing and visiting the Four Winds Lighthouse. During one New Year's Eve celebration at the lighthouse, he entertained the company by singing old Scotch ballads and dancing gracefully with Leslie Moore. When the Liberals finally won a general election, he quietly left the store where the election news arrived and woke up the local barber in the middle of the night to shave his beard and cut his hair. Afterwards, he became betrothed to Miss Cornelia Bryant.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c16 P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 c16 P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c35 P28](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0028), [v4 c35 P29](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0029), [v4 c37 P8](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0008), [v4 c38 P37](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0037)_
